name: T-cell Antigen Identification Benchmark
description: Benchmarks computational (AI-driven) methods for identifying T-cell antigens, comparing predictive accuracy, ranking performance, and experimental validation concordance across datasets.
reputation: Recognized within the computational immunology and bioinformatics communities as a focused benchmark for antigen-prediction methods, but adoption is moderate and largely domain-specific.
notes: Often limited by small or imbalanced datasets, label noise from experimental assays, and risk of dataset contamination; many methods rely on specialized features rather than general LLM capabilities.
